newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Communications rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Communications rated buy.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said it initiated coverage of American Communications Services Inc with a buy rating.
--"American Communications shares are trading 34 percent off its 52-week high. Our price target is $22," Chicago Corp said in a report issued Monday.
--American Communications is a rapidly growing competitive local exchange carrier with a strong competitive market position, Chicago Corp added.
--American Communications' stock was trading at 10-3/8, up 1/4.
